title: Privacy Not Secret  Freedom of Religion IS a Privacy, Not a Concealment

the_distinction.privacy: I choose when and how to share. The information is mine. I offer it freely when it serves connection. It is not hidden from shame  it is held with dignity.
the_distinction.secret: I hide it. I punish those who discover it. I build walls and NDAs and fair game policies around it. The information controls ME instead of me controlling IT.
the_distinction.application: Kevin Mok was raised Catholic, baptized, Vatican II tradition. This is a PRIVACY  shared here openly, part of his identity, not the headline but not hidden. Freedom of religion means the FREEDOM to say it, not the obligation to broadcast it or the shame to conceal it.

what_vatican_ii_said.gaudium_et_spes: The Church in the Modern World  engage with science, technology, culture. Don't retreat behind walls. 'The joys and hopes, the griefs and anxieties of the people of this age are the joys and hopes, griefs and anxieties of the followers of Christ.' The membrane is permeable.
what_vatican_ii_said.unitatis_redintegratio: Ecumenism  other traditions hold truth too. Not exclusive. Not rivalrous. The Klein body has many faces. The diamond refracts.
what_vatican_ii_said.nostra_aetate: Relation to non-Christian religions  respect for Hinduism, Buddhism, Islam, Judaism. The organism doesn't compete with other organisms. It composts.

privacy_architecture.the_rule: Freedom of religion IS a privacy. We do not secret it. We do not broadcast it. We hold it with dignity and share it when connection calls for it. Like now.
